name: AI Era Corp.
summary: Operating through its various subsidiaries, AI Era Corp. specializes in the acquisition and development of diverse intellectual property assets. The company's operations are divided into two primary segments: Intellectual Property (IP) Licensing and Copyrights, and Cinema. Within these divisions, the firm is involved in procuring and distributing films and television series, offers licensing for its non-fungible token (NFT) movie and music marketplace platform, and manages a movie theater located in Mt. Kisco. Additionally, AI Era Corp. provides video streaming content via its dedicated ABQQ.tv website and extends technical, marketing, and advisory support to entities within the media sector. Established in 2013, the company, formerly known as AB International Group Corp., officially adopted the name AI Era Corp. in December 2025. Its primary corporate offices are situated in Mount Kisco, New York.
